setup: Copied tracked gia/ into an independent directory with no .gia credentials; reused the real customer corpus and registry service, with a separate new project and serving profile.

suite.unsupportedCase: Passed in suite; test does not emit a per-query record

records.name: public organization membership and dated merged AI work
records.question: Find public Vercel members who authored a merged pull request from June 12, 2026 inclusive to September 11, 2026 exclusive in a repository with accepted repository-level ai concept evidence. Evidence may be explicit or inferred.

records.name: public organization membership and dated merged AI work
records.question: Among people publicly listed as members of the vercel organization, who authored an AI-repository pull request merged between 2026-06-12 inclusive and 2026-09-11 exclusive? Use accepted repository-level concept ai, including inferred evidence.

records.name: unknown location cannot satisfy an explicit location filter
records.question: Find people whose normalized location_city equals Berlin and who authored at least one merged pull request. Missing or unknown locations do not qualify, and do not infer locations from organizations.

records.name: BM25 pull-request text with profile and merge filters
records.question: Find people who authored merged pull requests mentioning reranking in their searchable PR text. Use full-text matching, and include only people whose follower count is known and below 500.

records.name: specific PR capability evidence rather than repository inheritance
records.question: Who authored merged pull requests with accepted PR-level reranking concept evidence? Inferred text or patch mentions count; repository-level evidence alone does not count.

records.name: distinct reviews of other authors
records.question: Who reviewed at least two distinct pull requests authored by other people? Multiple reviews of the same pull request count once; exclude self-reviews.

records.name: AI SDK and PostgreSQL on the same repository
records.question: Find authors of merged pull requests in a repository having both accepted repository-level npm:ai and postgresql concepts. Both concepts must belong to the same repository; either support level counts.

records.name: contributions across distinct repositories
records.question: Find people who authored merged pull requests in at least two distinct indexed repositories.

records.name: contributions across distinct repositories
records.question: Which contributors have merged PRs under their own authorship across two or more different repositories in this dataset?

records.name: profile absence does not substitute for PR evidence
records.question: Find authors of merged pull requests with accepted PR-level reranking evidence whose biography has no case-insensitive literal substring AI. A null biography satisfies the biography condition. Inferred reranking evidence counts.

records.name: current archive state and popularity constrain project evidence
records.question: Find people who authored a merged PR in a non-archived repository with more than 100 stars and accepted repository-level postgresql concept evidence. Inferred evidence counts. Archived repositories do not qualify.

records.name: known follower counts with repeated cross-project work
records.question: Find people with a known follower count below 500 who authored merged pull requests in at least two distinct repositories. Unknown follower counts do not qualify.

records.name: explicit disjunction across public affiliation and PR evidence
records.question: Find people satisfying either condition: they are a public Vercel member with at least one authored merged PR, OR they authored a merged PR with accepted PR-level reranking evidence. Include inferred evidence. This is OR, not AND.
